items.title: Stocks, Nasdaq Futures Climb as AI Trade Rebounds: Markets Wrap
items.excerpt: Stocks rose alongside US equity-index futures as investors returned to the artificial intelligence trade in the runup to the Thanksgiving holiday after a week of whipsawing.

items.title: Dubai Seals Deal to Form $159 Billion Islamic Banking Giant
items.excerpt: Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC said it’s buying Emirates Islamic Bank PJSC in an all-stock deal that will create one of the world’s largest listed Islamic-banking groups, with combined assets of about $159 billion.

items.title: Adani Firms Plan Public Bond Sale to Raise at Least $220 Million
items.excerpt: Two companies controlled by Indian billionaire Gautam Adani are looking to sell public bonds to raise at least 20 billion rupees ($220 million), according to people familiar with the matter, which would boost the nation’s subdued domestic public debt market.

items.title: Japan Life Insurers Complicate Yen Fight With Record Low Hedging
items.excerpt: Japan’s concerted push to bolster the yen is running into a major headwind, after the nation’s biggest life insurers slashed their currency hedging to a record low in the fiscal first half.

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 26
items.excerpt: Oil held a two-day gain as continued hostilities in the Middle East threatened to disrupt the recovery in the region’s crude exports.

items.title: Cracks in AI Stocks Sink the Once Reliable Carry Trade
items.excerpt: One of Wall Street’s most reliable wagers of 2026 is starting to lose its surefire status.

items.title: Copper Rebounds From Lowest This Year as Volatility Grips Metals
items.excerpt: Copper jumped more than 3% from an 11-month low, tracking gains in tech stocks even as doubts lingered over the durability of the AI boom and related industrial metals demand.

items.title: Rupee Hits 8-Month High as India November Stock Inflows Reach $14.7 Billion: INR
items.excerpt: ANZ Banking Group sees room for the rupee to gain further to 90-91 per dollar.

items.title: Hawkish Bank of Japan Member Seeks Quick Rate Hikes On Inflation
items.excerpt: A hawkish member of the Bank of Japan’s policy board called for early action to keep raising the BOJ’s benchmark rate, supporting market expectations for a rate hike next month.

items.title: KK Mart Starts $112 Million IPO Delayed by Malaysia Socks Row
items.excerpt: KK Mart Retail Bhd., the Malaysian convenience-store chain whose first attempt at an initial public offering was delayed by a religious controversy, is launching a 462 million ringgit ($112 million) share sale as it prepares to add hundreds of outlets across the country.

items.title: Shein’s Slow India Start Lays Bare Limits of Billionaire Ambani’s Retail Might
items.excerpt: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s return to India through a local partner is off to a slow start, due to supply chain snags, leadership uncertainty and a lack of proprietary technology that made the fast-fashion brand a hit.

items.title: Rupee Has Room to Rally Before RBI Steps In, Strategists Say
items.excerpt: India’s rupee is pulling away from its Asian peers, and strategists say the rally has further to run before the central bank steps in to buy dollars.

items.title: Situational Awareness Lost 65% in Wild Third Quarter, WSJ Says
items.excerpt: Situational Awareness told investors it lost 65% after fees in the third quarter, after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund’s implosion in July, according to the Wall Street Journal.

items.title: Lula Sounds Out Bradesco’s Luiz Trabuco to Join His Government
items.excerpt: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has sounded out Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi about joining his fourth-term government, according to people familiar with the matter, a move that could help ease investor concerns over Brazil’s deteriorating fiscal outlook.

items.title: Australia Capex Surges by Most Since Mining Boom on Data Centers
items.excerpt: Australian business investment surged by the most since the peak of the mining boom in the three months through September, driven by data center-related spending in a bright spot for an otherwise cooling economy.

items.title: Air India Chief Seeks to Cut $650 Million in Costs This Year
items.excerpt: Air India Ltd. is looking to cut costs by 60 billion rupees ($650 million) this financial year as its new chief executive officer outlined initiatives to revive the loss-making airline, people familiar with the matter said.

items.title: Modi’s Criticism of India Inc. Puts Weak Investment in Focus
items.excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s sharp criticism of Indian businesses last week exposed an underlying weakness in the economy’s booming growth story.

items.title: Gold Edges Lower as US Inflation Data Fuels Bets for Rate Hikes
items.excerpt: Gold edged lower, after rising on Wednesday, as inflation data reinforced bets the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates further.

items.title: Emerging Asia’s Best Bond Rally Seen Extending in Philippines
items.excerpt: Philippine government bonds look poised to build on this month’s sharp rally as expectations of easing price pressures and a landmark global index inclusion may stimulate fresh demand next year, according to some market watchers.

items.title: China 2027 Growth to Top 4.5%, Ex-Official Says
items.excerpt: China’s economy is on track to grow more than 4.5% in 2027, according to former Vice Finance Minister Zhu Guangyao.
